funFacts: Snakes smell with their tongues, collecting particles and analyzing them with the Jacobson's organ.
Some turtles can breathe through their butts — using cloacal respiration.
Chameleons don't change color to camouflage — they do it to regulate temperature and communicate.
Crocodiles have been around for 200 million years, surviving the dinosaur extinction.
